description: This file defines a final class 'TalkModeController' that manages the state and interactions related to 'Talk Mode' within the application. It includes methods for enabling/disabling talk mode, updating phases and levels, pausing/resuming, stopping speaking, and exiting talk mode. The class interacts with various shared instances and external components such as overlay controllers, runtime handlers, and connection managers to coordinate the talk mode functionality.

classes.name: TalkModeController
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for controlling and managing the state of 'Talk Mode', including enabling/disabling, updating phases, pausing, and stopping speech.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables Talk Mode, updating UI overlays and notifying the runtime, with special handling for resumed wake listeners if disabled.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current phase of Talk Mode and communicates the change to the gateway connection with consideration of paused state.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the voice level indicator in the overlay.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes Talk Mode, updating the overlay and notifying the runtime and connection.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of Talk Mode.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops the current speech in Talk Mode with a specified reason.

methods.name: exitTalkMode
methods.description: Exits Talk Mode by disabling it in the shared app state.
